item.text:
The report is consistent and complete; nothing left to correct within this budget.

Final state of the audit — [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_01-10-40-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md):

**F2 (production code, confirmed and reproduced).** [Commands.java:766](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_01-10-40-zookeeper-baseline/work/zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/admin/Commands.java:766) constructs the admin `snapshot` command's rate limiter with `TimeUnit.MICROSECONDS`, while the interval it uses comes from `zookeeper.admin.rateLimiterIntervalInMS` (default `300000`, documented in `zookeeperAdmin.md` as "Defaults to 5 mins") and `RestoreCommand` (line 646) uses `TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS`. `RateLimiter` converts with `unit.toMillis`, so the endpoint enforces 300 ms instead of 5 minutes — a documented protection against repeated whole-datatree snapshot streaming is effectively absent. Reproduction kept at [work/repro/SnapshotRateLimitCheck.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_01-10-40-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/SnapshotRateLimitCheck.java) with its compiled class and `out.txt`; the report records the exact commands and output, plus why the suite misses it (harness zeroes the interval at `ZKTestCase.java:102`, no assertion on 429, admin test classes excluded from the earlier sweep until I ran them — 42/42 pass).

**F3 (test code, observed as a side effect).** `ZkDatabaseCorruptionTest.java:190` creates `new FileTxnSnapLog(new File("foo"), new File("bar"))`, leaving `zookeeper-server/foo` and `bar` (`version-2`) in the module tree — contradicting the release-noted ZOOKEEPER-4780 fix and dirtying the source tree between runs.

**Negative and analytical results retained:** 239 test classes / 1805+ tests executed under `isolated_exec` with every election/Zab/recovery/reconfig/durability class passing; F1 (`QuorumPeerMainTest#testLeaderOutOfView`) analysed from the server log and falsified as a run-to-run race; E1/E2 documented as environment blockers (sandbox hostname resolution in `/etc/hosts`, external DNS); the consensus-critical source reviewed against its documented contracts (quorum arithmetic, leader/learner handshake, persistence, request pipeline, defaults, plus the 3.9.x fix-presence checklist) with no deviation beyond F2; and §6 lists what a continuation should pick up. The captured implementation and dependencies were never modified — diagnostics live only under `work/repro/` and `work/audit-notes/`.
